characters.name: Penny Proud
characters.description: The main protagonist. Academic Athlete: She is a straight A student and is also good at both basketball and football. The Ace: She's a downplayed, almost zig-zagged example. While she's definitely not flawless and has manyButt-Monkeymoments, Penny is still an attractive, confident, charismaticAcademic Athleteand natural leader who is implied to be popular at school,has had countless male love interests, and was even voted "most likely to succeed" in her school yearbook. It's often implied that the reason theAlpha BitchLaCienegapicks on her so much is at least partly due to envy. Acquired Situational Narcissism:In "A Star Is Scorned" when she decides to quit LPDZ and gets her friends fired in order to go solo.In the revival episode "Bad Influencer", Penny lets being an influencer get to her head, where she starts using her power to "cancel" anyone who disagrees with her. In "A Star Is Scorned" when she decides to quit LPDZ and gets her friends fired in order to go solo.

characters.name: Oscar Proud
characters.description: Penny's overprotective father. While he loves his family, he sees money before non-material happiness. Abusive Offspring: Lets out insulting witty remarks at Suga Mama at any given opportunity. Though to be fair, she hasn't exactly been (and still isn't) the best mother towards him. Abusive Parents: Oscar does love his family but he has his moments, especially inLouder and Prouder. Usually this involves being overcontrolling on his children and pressuring his own dreams onto them. Achievements in Ignorance: You'd be surprised how often he warps the laws of physics by simply being so inept at whatever he's doing. Aesop Amnesia:Every time Oscar is given an Aesop about how he shouldn’t be so protective of Penny in an episode, the aesop ends up not sticking and he goes back to being overprotective in the next episode. Oscar admits he has the hardest time letting that sink in.He also has to learn a few times to not try to relive his glory days through his kids.

characters.name: Trudy Proud
characters.description: Penny's mother. She works as a veterinarian and, according to Penny, keeps everything in the Proud household together. Berserk Button: Trudydoesn'tlike being lied to as even Penny and her friends are not safe. But Not Too Black: "The Shade of It All" brings up how Trudy is actually a lighter shade of Black. Catchphrase: Usually when she is worried about her kids (or even Oscar), she'll often shout "MY BABIES". Clingy Jealous Girl: Like howOscarcan be, Trudy can get easily jealous when he starts flirting with another woman.

characters.name: Suga Mama
characters.description: Penny's paternal grandmother and the mother of Oscar. As a kid, she was involved inThe Glorious War of Sisterly Rivalrywith Spice, Oscar’s aunt. After Spice turned out to be a witch, Suga Mama got fed up and came to hate magic. As an adult, Suga Mama is a hip old woman who favors her oldest son Bobby over Oscar. She is not overtly nasty to Penny and Trudy, but she's very mean to Oscar in a catty sort of way. She also appears to be humorously athletic despite her age. Abhorrent Admirer: She has the hots for Papi, who clearly does not feel the same, but since he only speaks Spanish, Suga Mama never catches on. Abusive Mom: Even though she really does love him, Suga Mama is ahorriblemom to Oscar. She's abusive towards her son both physically and verbally and is likely the very core of where all his own problems come from. Action Girl: As a young girl in "Old Towne Road", she actually had excellent bullriding skills, where she exhausted the animal. Too bad her father dismissed her due to her gender. Affectionate Nickname: Dr. Payne calls her "Suga Bear".

characters.name: BeBeandCeCeProud
characters.description: Penny's younger twin siblings, a boy (BeBe) and a girl (CeCe). Abusive Offspring: Sometimes they are rude to their father and even beat him up. Annoying Younger Siblings: Not that they can help it.At least it seems that way. Born Lucky: When they’re aged up in “Twins to Tweens”, everything magically goes right for them at Penny’s expense. It’s hard to say if this applies to them currently. Brainy Baby: Times two. They do things that no infants can do their age. In the revival, they've been aged up to two years old but their intellect has been put more into the spotlight.BeBehimself has more potential, though he has to deal with autism not letting him properly register pain or fear.

characters.name: Bobby Proud
characters.description: Oscar's older brother who likes to sing. Abhorrent Admirer: He has the hots for Trudy's sister, Diana, who doesn't have a positive opinion of him. She'll sometimes give him credit for trying though. Art Evolution: Perhaps the most notable change in his design inLouder and Prouderis that he has more visible ears, which he lacked in the original series. Ascended Extra: Despite being a member of the Proud family, he was more of a reoccurring character during the shows original run. InLouder and Prouderhe gets promoted to the main cast and has more screen-time than before. Big Eater: If there's one thing Bobby loves more than singing, it's stuffing his face. Especially when he doesn't have to pay for it.

characters.name: Puff
characters.description: Suga Mama's pet poodle. Anthropomorphic Shift: Puff goes through a brief, downplayed one in “Bad Influence(r)”, as a result of Dr. Payne’s boot camp, which has him jacked up and standing on two legs. Butt-Monkey: He's one of the main sources of physical slapstick in the series. Canine Companion: To Suga Mama, being a poodle she is often seen carrying. This case goes even further, as he even helps Suga Mama was able to pass her driver's test. Even the Dog Is Ashamed: He's a poodle who, like everyone else, looks down on Oscar for his foolishness.

characters.name: Mr. Chips
characters.description: Oscar Proud's pet monkey that was introduced in Season 2 and started to help him out more in the Proud Snacks Factory. Amazing Technicolor Wildlife: InLouder and Prouder, his fur and skin are both shades of purple, as opposed to his natural brown furin the original series. Butt-Monkey: Pun aside, Mr. Chips is constantly at the abuse of Oscar but will often return the favor if needed. Hidden Depths: Despite being a monkey that is always dragged around by Oscar, Mr. Chips is actually pretty good at his job at the Proud Snacks factory. It even got to a point where he (a monkey) and Peabo (a child) are able to work a forklift while Oscar can't. You Don't Look Like You: He looks drastically different inLouder and Prouderthan he did in the original series, having purple-ish fur and looking older and more tired.

characters.name: Dijonay Jones
characters.description: Penny's selfish, funny, caring, and enthusiastic best friend(?). Abhorrent Admirer: Towards Sticky. She is usually unaware of how much he finds her annoying. She's also completely unaware that she's the reason he willingly gotPut on a BusinLouder and Prouder. And then Dijonay becomes this to KG, Maya's brother, for a while. Aesop Amnesia: All the freakin' time. Watch and lose count of how many times she's learned not to take her family for granted, to be a better friend to Penny, not to be so shallow, etc. ByLouder and Prouder, she at least has the first one down, and goes out of her way to make sure her family is taken care of, and is very defensive of her siblings. Ambiguously Bi: It's no secret at all that she's attracted to boys (just ask Sticky), but she shows some possible attraction to girls as well. Aside from someHomoerotic Subtextmoments with Penny, her reaction to seeing Kwok's arranged wife in "Romeo Must Wed" seemed like more than just admiration. In the revival, her reaction to seeingLaCienega'smore developed body was, "Who isthatsnack?"before seeing her temporarily hairy face. Interestingly this is also theexactsame line she uses when seeingher official newLove Interestand boyfriendDarius for the first time. Balloon Belly: In "Tween Town", when she drinks a large amount of soda with Penny while the adults are gone.

characters.name: LaCienegaBoulevardez
characters.description: Penny's frenemy, and the daughter of Felix and Sunset Boulevardez. Academic Alpha Bitch: Downplayed.LaCienegais the typical popular mean girl and not openly bookish, but she still manages to perform academically well and get straight A's. The way she insults Penny carries a certain level of cleverness and wit, showing she is well-read to a degree. Of course, she doesn't seem to fare well in P.E., and Coach Collins impliesLaCienegahas given half-assed excuses before. Adaptational Villainy: In both the show and the revival, she's just a regularJerkasswho insults people but draws the line at actually seriously hurting anyone. In the non-canonTheme Song Takeover, however, she outrightkidnapsPenny andties her up, which ismuchmore sociopathic than anything she's canonically done. Adaptational Wimp: In the original series,LaCienegawas not afraid to confront Penny physically, as seen in "Rumors", and it was implied that she had some martial arts skills. In the non-canonTheme Song Takeover, however, sheran awaywhen Penny tried to beat her up. Alpha Bitch: An interesting case. While she is a rich, beautiful, mean but superficially charming girl who’s also a cheerleader, she is almost never actually seen actively bullying unpopular kids (since she's too busybeing mean to Pennyinstead), is not actually the cheer captain (Dijonay is), is part of the protagonist's friend group despiteconstantly butting heads with her, and lacks aGirl Posse(as Penny actually seems to beThe Leaderof her friend group). Otherwise, she fits this trope like a glove.

characters.name: Zoey Howser
characters.description: Penny's shy, geeky friend. She's a sweet, agreeable and helpful girl. Actor Allusion: For the "Up All Night 90s Party" in the Season 3 finale of the revival, she dresses asPunky Brewster, whomher voice actressis famous for playing (despite the fact the show only aired during the 80s). Bespectacled Cutie: Zoey's large glasses compliments her nerdy and shy personality and makes her look cuter. Big Eater: She gains this trait inLouder and Prouder, which may be due to her growth spurt. Chronic Backstabbing Disorder: She's not as horrible as Dijonay andLaCienega, but even Zoey can abandon Penny when she caves into peer pressure.

characters.name: Sticky Webb
characters.description: Penny's other best friend and a cool tech nerd. Black and Nerdy: He's very tech-savvy. Butt-Monkey: Has a tendency to rival Oscar in this regard, depending on the episode. Cool Shades: They also come with a built-in camera. Green-Eyed Monster: He becomes this when Dijonay goes out with Duke in "Surf and Turf".

characters.name: Michael Collins
characters.description: Penny's flamboyant, closest male friend. Becomes part of her main friend group inLouder and Prouder, where he’s depicted as openly gay and gender non-conforming. Adaptational Sexuality:Averted in a very interesting way.In the original series, he was never revealed to bestraightor LGBT in any other capacity. In the revival, he's allowed to beCamp Gay. The writers reveal that he wasalwaysgay. They justweren't allowed to say itatthe time of the original series. The episodethat focuses on him in the original seasonsused his frustration with being bullied over being differentto touch on the subject and help kids in the show's audience who felt the same. "All Grown Up" Remark: Went from the awkward short kid to a tall and flamboyantly stylish teen by the revival, as Penny notes upon seeing him. All of the Other Reindeer: "Who You Callin' a Sissy?" explores how he's often bullied because of his effeminate nature. Art Evolution: Michael went through two different design changes throughout the franchise. His biggest design change by far was inLouder and Prouder.

characters.name: Maya Leibowitz-Jenkins
characters.description: A new kid in town who is a young activist. Beneath the Mask: Maya presents herself as severe and unyielding, but underneath she is a sensitive person. Considering all the crap she and her brother have been given for having two dads and being adopted, she’s had to spend most of her life soldiering on even if it hurts her. Beware the Quiet Ones: Maya isn’t as much of a conversationalist as Penny’s other friends, but when she feels strongly about something, she is quite passionately driven. Black-and-White Morality: Maya definitely has this mindset. The moment anyone shows any selfishness she’s quick to write them off as bad people. It also goes for any social issue she addresses, like trying to rescue the panda when he didn’t want to. Brother–Sister Team: Maya and her brother are quite inseparable.

characters.name: Kareem Abdul-Jabbar Brown
characters.description: Penny's boyfriend inLouder and Prouder. Deliberate Under-Performance: When Oscar tries to have Kareem play basketball for his team (because he's tall), Kareem misses all his shots. It's later revealed that he does have basketball talents, but was deliberately missing his throws so that Oscar wouldn't force him to play. Gentle Giant: He's a very tall but very nice young man. Huge Guy, Tiny Girl: At 6'6 he towers over his 5'4 girlfriend Penny (and almost all the rest of the characters). Mellow Fellow: He's pretty calm, and never actually gets mad at Penny when she blows him off, instead being disappointed in her.

characters.name: Sunset Boulevardez
characters.description: Felix's wife and Trudy's best friend. She is the mother ofLaCienega, the wife of Felix and is a police officer. Control Freak: When she learns her daughter is a natural gymnast in "A Perfect 10," Sunset begins to project herself into her daughter because Sunset couldn't make it as a gymnast in her youth. It's so bad that she often forgets it's her daughter (nother) being praised. Cool Aunt: Unlike her sister, Sunset doesn't hold high standards forLaCienegaor her niece, [LaBrea] and treats them equally. The latter wishes that Sunset would be her mother. Doting Parent: One of the contributors toLaCienega's spoiled personality. For reference, she used her profession to threaten to arrest judges so that they would vote for her daughter. It's implied she's like that because her parents put pressure on her as a kid and this is her way ofBreaking the Cycle of Bad Parenting. On the other hand, it seems she spends money on her daughter to satisfyherown ego as far her sister is concerned. Double Standard: Abuse, Female on Male: Her method of courting Felix definitely wouldn't fly if the genders were reversed.

characters.name: Felix Boulevardez
characters.description: Oscar's neighbor and best friend. He is the father ofLaCienegaand the husband of Sunset. Big Fun: He's fat and a very friendly, fun guy to be around. Bumbling Dad: Even more so than Oscar, probably explaining how someone so good-natured ended up with a daughter likeLaCienega. And, for someone who owns a construction company, he couldn’t tell the difference between a fumigation truck and a helium truck. Butt-Monkey: Sometimes. When he shares scenes with Oscar, he can be a victim of slapstick and he and Oscar are both dominated by their wives. Doting Parent: He has a tendency to indulgeLaCienega, which is why she ended up such aSpoiled Brat. In the revival, he does it way less than his wife does, who does it to satisfy her own ego against her sister.

characters.name: Papi Boulevardez
characters.description: Suga Mama'sLove Interestwho's also Felix's father, Sunset's father-in-law andLaCienega's paternal grandfather. A Day in the Limelight: The episode "Thelma & Luis" focuses on him. Deadpan Snarker: Towards Suga Mama but it's in Spanish, so she never understands. Depending on the Writer: Whether or not his family can understand him varies. Does Not Speak Common: He clearly understands English perfectly well, yet all of his dialogue is in Spanish, as he never really participates in conversations, just heckles people.

characters.name: LaBreaAvenúñez
characters.description: LaCienega'scousin, whom she dislikes both for having a history of pranking her, and always stealing her friends’ attention away from her. She first appears in "Raging Bully", where, toLaCienega'sdismay, is in town for her quinciñera, and has become much skinnier since the last time she saw her. Affably Evil: She's legitimately friendly to Penny and her friends, but is also ruthless enough to play pranks onLaCienegathat could get her seriously hurt. She later drops the "evil" part and the two girls become friends. Big Beautiful Woman: As revealed later, she's actually wearing multiple corsets because her mother, Melrose, wouldn’t let her come toLaCi's quincinera unless she was skinnier than her, as part of all Melrose's other attempts to one up her sister. When she takes it off, she's just as pretty as she was before. Clashing Cousins: She'sLaCienega'scousin, and is (or, was) also the one person the latter hates even more thanPenny. Disproportionate Retribution: Make no mistake,LaCienegaisa pain in the neck, but some ofLaBrea's ways of getting back at her areveryexcessive, such as getting birds to attack her or strapping her to a rocket, even if, in aZany Cartoonlike this, characters likeOscarhave suffered far worse.

characters.name: Melrose Avenúñez
characters.description: LaCieniga'saunt, Sunset's sister, andLaBrea'smom. Abusive Parents: She shows little to no affection toLaBrea, and due to not being able to afford a trainer both makes her diet and stuff herself into several corsets so she can be skinnier than her cousin, apparently not allowing her to go to her quincinera until she was. EvenLaCienegawas shocked when she heard about this. Although it's implied that her and Sunset's mother wasn't much better. Always Second Best: She feels as if she was always this to Sunset, which is why she's always so mean to the latter. Big Sister Bully: She is Sunset's older sister, and is always giving the latter a hard time. Freudian Excuse: Is smug and condescending to almost everyone from Trudy to especially her own sister, to the point she even lies to her and Sunset's parents thatLaCienega's quincinera was cancelled so they end up not showing up. She brags about how much more luxuriousLaBrea's quincinera will be, and shows little affection towardsLaBreaand is revealed to have tried to get her to lose weight (which is why she’s wearing four layers of shape wear to look skinny) and wouldn’t let her go to her cousin's quincinera unless she was skinnier than her, likely as another way to one up her sister. However, it’s revealed later that her and Sunset's mother always pitted them against each other, making her feel second best, and she recently went through a divorce and is struggling both emotionally and financially, the latter of which has caused her to now be able to giveLaBreaa quincinera.

characters.name: Barry and Randall "Randy" Leibowitz-Jenkins
characters.description: Maya and KG's dads; an interracial gay couple. Barry is a cop, and Randy is a loan officer at the bank. Big Guy, Little Guy: Barry is the big guy— a big, strong cop—to Randall's little guy—a short, intellectual loan officer. Happily Married: Both these married gay men are deeply in love with each other and are not afraid to show it. Love at First Sight: In "A Perfect 10", it was revealed that Randy injured himself during his gymnastics competition years ago. Barry, who was working as a paramedic at the time, check up on Randy. The two quickly fell for each other as they met and the rest is history. Does Not Know His Own Strength: He's so ridiculously strong, that he accidentally injures Oscar twice both times while greeting him. Not hard to see why he was hired into the police force.

characters.name: Francis "KG" Leibowitz-Jenkins
characters.description: Maya’s apathetic gamer brother. Ambiguously Gay: More like "Ambiguously Asexual". Despite several girlsand Michaelbeing attracted to him, he doesn't seem interested in anyone himself.Penny:Guess he's not into girls, huh?Michael:That's what's up!LaCienega:Oryou, Michael. Brilliant, but Lazy: KG is a tech genius, but there are days he just can't be bothered to use his brain especially when others egg him on. Brutal Honesty: KG won't hold back telling you off for being insensitive or ignorant. Catchphrase: A very high-pitched "Sheeeesh!", usually said when Dijonay shows interest in him. Becomes anAbandoned Catchphrasein season two, however, especially since Dijonay now has a boyfriend, though he does say it again once in the third season finale, albeit not in the same manner as before.

characters.name: Myron Lewinski
characters.description: A classmate who has a crush on Penny, and later, Zoey. Black and Nerdy: He's black and is known as a geek at his and Penny's school. Casanova Wannabe: He could often be seen trying to hit on other girls in his school, most notably Penny, with little to no success. Chick Magnet: Temporarily becomes one in "Rumors" when his and Penny's classmates think something more went on between the two of them during Penny's party, whereas Pennyis teased and looked down upon for it. Dark Horse Victory: In the election episode, he ends up winning since he didn't resort to trickery (Penny on the Gross Sisters' behalf) nor bribery (Wizard Jr.).

characters.name: Omar Phillips
characters.description: A jock and one of Penny's friends. Adapted Out:Subverted. While he didn't appear in Season 1 of the revival series, he does return in the second season. Chick Magnet: Most of the girls in his school have a crush on him. The Ditz: He is a dimwitted guy. Sometimes, he is unable to remember Penny’s name, as seen in “Puff’s Magic Adventure.” Dumb Jock: He's a quarterback and as mentioned, is not entirely smart.

characters.name: The Chang Triplets
characters.description: Billy, Julie, and Debbie Chang are fraternal triplets who are the smartest kids in Penny's class. Academic Athlete: They also practice karate. In the revival, Julie mentions that she's on the soccer team. Adapted Out: They are neither seen nor mentioned several episodes into the revival series.Subvertedas of Season 2, where they finally make a reappearance. All Asians Know Martial Arts: They are Chinese, but they are trained in theOkinawanart of karate. Ascended Extra: Although not to the same extent as Michael, Billy gets more focus inLouder and Prouderas he gets to hang out with Penny's core friend group a lot more often than he and his sisters ever got to in the original series. The fact that he is seemingly in a relationship with Maya helps in this case.

characters.name: Duke Anoi
characters.description: Penny's surfer friend who resided from Hawaii before moving to California. Chuck Cunningham Syndrome: He hasn’t reappeared inLouder and Prouder, unlike most of the cast from the original series. However, a visual gag in "Will the Real Young Toddler Please Stand Up?" shows his name on a list of kids in Willy T. Ribbs Middle School, implying that he still goes there. Nice Guy: He’s a pretty friendly and laid-back person. Operation: Jealousy: After getting spurned by Sticky, Dijonay decides to get back at him by dating Duke and so Sticky pretends to date Penny in response. After all that, he breaks up with Dijonay and becomes friends with Sticky. Remember the New Guy?: He makes his first appearance in the second season episode "Camping Trip", but everyone acts like they've known him a while and he doesn't even get an introductory episode.

characters.name: Peabo
characters.description: The Prouds' 9-year-old neighbor. Adorably Precocious Child: He's nine, but acts more mature than Oscar, who is a grown man. He seems to see everything that goes on and knows the things that go wrong. Artistic License – Child Labor Laws: He's a nine-year-old boy who works at the Proud Snacks factory. He's even able to operate a forklift while Oscar can't. He has also worked for Wizard Kelly and Trudy. Bizarre Taste in Food: He is theonlyone to genuinelylikeProud Snacks. The Cassandra: Peabo can easily predict when something wrong will happen to Oscar, but Oscar doesn’t believe him. But, some of the accidents Oscar gets himself into could’ve been avoided if he had just exercised common sense.

characters.name: Dr. Payne
characters.description: The Proud Family's doctor who loves the whole family (minus Oscar). He also tends to charge outrageous prices for even the most minimum of treatments. Bald Head of Toughness: He's balding inLouder and Prouderbut he hasn't lost an ounce of his tough demeanor. Berserk Button: While Oscar in general pisses him off, Payne talks specific umbrage whenever Oscar doesn’t “RESPECT HIS SWEET LIL SUGA MAMA!” Catchphrase: He likes to tell Oscar, "Quiet, fool!!!" Dr. Jerk: Only to Oscar—and to be fair, Oscar usuallybrings it on himself.Despite his dislike of Oscar, he still tries to give him the best medical care possible.

characters.name: Darrius Saint Vil
characters.description: A preppy student of Haitian descent who is introduced in season two ofLouder and Prouder. He becomes Dijonay's new boyfriend, even transferring to Willy T. Ribbs Middle School after the events of his debut episode. Cheaters Never Prosper: He hooked up with Dijonay to get access to her copy of the Willie T. Ribbs Middle School debate team's strategy book. It fails when she and the team flip the script on him and do a stellar spoken word performance that gives them the win. Easily Forgiven: While he did use Dijonay to try to cheat, his and her body language after her win show that he does regret his actions, but she forgives him, and they both agree to continue their relationship. Official Couple: He stays Dijonay's boyfriend after his debut. Satellite Love Interest: Becomes this to Dijonay after his debut, although he’s also shown to get along well with the guys.

characters.name: Sista Spice
characters.description: Asshole Victim: She suffers what turns out to be a painful spell caused by Suga Mama reflecting the magic back at her with a garbage can. Given that she had spent the past few days badmouthing Oscar for literally no reason at all beyond her view of him as a "boob", pretty much everyone considers it a suitable punishment. Bitch in Sheep's Clothing: She's pretended to be a nice person to everyone, even Oscar. After he openly admits he wished she was his mother, after leaving the room, it's shown to the audience and her assistant Shaza she has a very low opinion of him. Bright Is Not Good: Her signature outfit is pink and purple like Suga Mama's, but her soul is as black as the night itself. Broken Pedestal: While it isn't outright said, the fact she's never mentioned again makes it clear Oscar doesn't hold a high opinion of her anymore. Color Motif: Pink, to go with her sickly sweet personality as well as Suga Mama’s signature outfit.

characters.name: Ray Ray Proud Jr.
characters.description: Big Eater: He and his baby brother S'mo eat an entire dinner that was prepared for the family and their visiting relatives. Gentle Giant: He's a big boy with a friendly nature.

characters.name: Boonetta and Ray Ray Proud Sr.
characters.description: Big Eater: According to Trudy, they ate her and Oscar's wedding cake. The Bus Came Back: Ray Ray Sr. finally returns inLouder and Prouderin the episode "The Soul Vibrations" where he helps Penny and the others get into the back to see Giselle. According to Oscar, the reason he's been gone for so long is because Oscar had blocked him over 10 years go for not paying him back $10 that he lent to him. Fat and Proud: His fatness is only second to his colorful personality. NO INDOOR VOICE: Most of the time, he talks pretty loudly. Innocently Insensitive: They mean well and act friendly but they do cause a few problems with Trudy's family from being clueless about how the Parkers respond to their behavior.

characters.name: Pa Towne
characters.description: Abusive Parents: In most of his screen time, he only seems to put down Suga Mama. Boyfriend-Blocking Dad: When Pa found out about Suga Mama's plan to elope with Quanah so they could get married, Pa stopped this from happening by hanging Quanah upside down over a cliff and threatened to down drop him. Bear Hug: How he welcomes Oscar to the family—with a large, squeezing hug. Grandparental Age Dissonance: He should be long dead given his daughter is already an elderly person. He looks to be in amazing shape for his age, too. Grandparent Favoritism: He never got to know his grandson, but after seeing him be a natural cowboy, he’s grown fond of him. Oscar couldn’t be happier to have an elder relative that respects him.

characters.name: Diana Parker
characters.description: Affectionate Nickname: Is called "Aunt Dee" by Penny. Fiery Redhead: She is a sweetheart to both Penny and her sister, but she is mostly this towards Oscar and his cousins because she sees them as mongrels and not worth the crud on her boots. Foil: To her sister Trudy in "Romeo Must Wed", who's a lot more mild-mannered and modest in comparison to her rich and famous older sister. According to Trudy, it's just "the diva in her" and it occasionally lets Diana walk all over Trudy.To Bobby in "Behind Family Lines". Bobby, Oscar's older brother, is an unsuccessful singer who lives with his mother and is pleasant to his brother's family. Diana is Trudy's older sister who is a very rich and successful Broadway actress who won't hesitate to express annoyance to her brother-in-law or his extended family. To Bobby in "Behind Family Lines". Bobby, Oscar's older brother, is an unsuccessful singer who lives with his mother and is pleasant to his brother's family. Diana is Trudy's older sister who is a very rich and successful Broadway actress who won't hesitate to express annoyance to her brother-in-law or his extended family. The Friend Nobody Likes: While Penny and Trudy adore her, it's strongly implied that they're the only ones. Oscar obviously despises her for treating him like a servant, and while Suga Mama enjoys getting gifts from her, the rest of the family from Oscar's side has to tolerate her presence. It's possible even Bobby's devotion to Diana is more out of lust, than actual love, considering how focused he is on warming up to her.

characters.name: Chanel Parker
characters.description: Bully Turned Buddy: She spends the first few minutes being nothing but condescending to Penny, but then sides with her when her parents go to war with Oscar's cousins. Everyone Has Standards: Normally, she has a dour opinion of her Aunt Trudy's home. After herHeel–Face Turn, however, it hits her that her parents are intolerable. Chanel is actually horrified by this since she, like Penny and Ray Ray Jr., see each other as family. It gives her the courage to try to reprimand her family for fussing and fighting. Lovable Alpha Bitch: She's a bit stuck up and can't hide that she's used to living in a nicer home than the Proud Family's house, but she seems pleased about the Twins baptism and gets along with Penny and Ray Ray Jr. while their parents are busy fighting for most of the episode. Graceful Ladies Like Purple: She's constantly wearing a purple sweater. The Hedonist: Prior to herHeel–Face Turn, she really doesn't care much about Penny and her room, enjoying herself and not hiding the fact that she is used to sleeping in a place with a concierge.

characters.name: Rueben Parker and Leslie Parker
characters.description: Cool Car: He has a fancySUVfrom a model not out on the market. Evil Uncle: Not quite evil, but still snobby to Oscar's cousins. Happily Married: For all his other flaws, he and Leslie really love each other. Obnoxious In-Laws: Zigzagged. He's perfectly nice to Oscar, but he feuds a lot with Ray Ray Sr. and his wife. Pet the Dog: He's the only one of the Parker family who treats Oscar nicely, showing off his new car because he thinks Oscar will enjoy the bells and whistles. While he does get testy with Oscar's relatives he never takes it out on Oscar.

characters.name: Maureen and Dr. Vincent Parker
characters.description: Actually Pretty Funny: Vincent admits with Oscar that seeing Suga Mama clocking Maureen in the head was funny. The Bully: He enjoys belittling his in-laws and keeping Oscar under his thumb. He approves and even encourages his wife to do the same. Even Evil Has Loved Ones: While he's not truly evil, Vincent is a deeply unpleasant man in the eyes of Oscar’s relatives - while he belittles Oscar, he is genuinelyHappily Marriedto Maureen and he is aDoting Grandparentto Penny and the twins. In "Behind Family Lines", Maureen becomes outraged with Boonetta when she blames Little Ray Ray for the theft of Rueben's truck. Everyone Has Standards: They appear to invoke this with regards to the other Prouds, as while Penny seems to love them, it's implied that Oscar and Suga Mama do not and only tolerate them because they're family. Doting Grandparent: They are fairly sweet to Penny and the twins.

characters.name: Myrtle Towne
characters.description: She’s the wife of Pa Towne and Suga Mama's stepmother.

characters.name: Charles Towne
characters.description: He resides in a desolate town named Towne, Oklahoma and is the brother of Suga Mama and Spice.

characters.name: Chuck Towne
characters.description: He is Suga Mama's baby brother

characters.name: Celia
characters.description: She is a close friend of Suga Mama. Nice Girl: She is a nice women who doesn’t mind a conversation.

characters.name: Raquel Towne
characters.description: She is the wife of Suga Mama's baby brother Chuck.

characters.name: Peaches
characters.description: She is one of Suga Mama's in-laws as she is married to her nephew Man Towne.

characters.name: Harriet Towne
characters.description: She is the daughter of Suga Mama's nephew June Bug and his wife Germaine. She resides in Towne, Oklahoma where Suga Mama was born and raised.

characters.name: Man-Man Towne
characters.description: He is the 14-year-old son of Man Towne, making him Penny Proud's cousin. He resides in a desolate town called, "Towne, Oklahoma" where Suga Mama was born and raised.

characters.name: Tiko and Tika Towne
characters.description: They are twin-children of Chuck Towne, Suga Mama’s baby brother.

characters.name: Karl Anthony Towne
characters.description: The founder of Towne, Oklahoma, where Suga Mama and her family originated. He has a statue at the front gates of the town with a plaque dedicated to him.

characters.name: Wizard Kelly
characters.description: An incredibly wealthy, very smart, and famous businessman who made his fortune playing professional basketball. In the revival series, he gets elected as mayor of Emilyville (formerly Smithville; known as Wizville during the original series). Accidental Misnaming: He likes to call Zoey "Susie" no matter how many times Zoey corrects him. The Ace: A legendary basketball player with enough money to own the city and everything in it. Affably Evil: He's a legitimately friendly guy who would love to help you... just as long as you can pay him. The episode, "The Altos" had him helping the others punishthe Altosin the end, and he genuinely loves and cares for his wife and son. Thisdepends on what episode you watch, as he's sometimes moreFaux Affably Evilor just a plain oldJerkass. Always Someone Better: He's everything Oscar tries and fails to be.

characters.name: Ginger Snaps Kelly
characters.description: Flat Character: Ginger Snaps doesn't get much screentime in the series and is only there as Wizard Kelly's wife who could've ended up with Oscar. Formerly Fit: She's noticably chubbier inLouder and Prouder. Hollywood Tone-Deaf: The only time her voice is heard is "singing" the National Anthem in "The Altos", and it's pretty clear that Wizard Kelly didn't marry her for her talent. Huge Guy, Tiny Girl: She's this with her husband, Wizard. Ms. Fanservice: Very attractive and wears clothing that shows off her body a lot.

characters.name: Wizard "Lil' Wiz" Kelly Jr.
characters.description: Everyone Has Standards: Despite being willing to bribe his way to becoming class president and being as smug as his dad, not even Lil' Wiz would resort to mudslinging to get an edge in the votes. His father on the other hand... Jerk with a Heart of Gold: Lil' Wiz may be very arrogant like his father but he is definitely a lot nicer than his dad. Lil' Wiz always treat his girlfriends well and there are lines not even he would cross. Lean and Mean: Lil' Wiz is very skinny and has the arrogance of a rich boy. Like Father, Like Son: Lil' Wiz takes a lot from his father. From hisVerbal Ticto beingThird-Person Person. Morality Pet: To his father, the Wizard. The Wizard is one of the biggest jerkasses in the show, but he does show genuine love and affection for his son. He kicked the people who accused his son of stealing out of his house and helped Little Wiz win the middle school election by spending millions.

characters.name: Merlin Kelly
characters.description: Wizard Kelly’s father. Evil Laugh: When he confronts Suga Mama about Giselle signing the contract with him, he gives off a baritone evil laugh towards her as he gloats. The Faceless: Just like his son, Merlin is very tall and the most you will ever see is his mouth or forehead. It Runs in the Family: Apparently, everyone in the Kelly family take after him, who is an arrogant, shifty man. Posthumous Character: It’s heavily implied Merlin is long dead by the time of the series.

characters.name: The Gross Sisters
characters.description: Three sisters who constantly bully Penny and her friends into giving them their money. Abhorrent Admirer: Olei develops a crush on KG in "Father Figures", to which he rejects her by running away. Amazing Technicolor Population: They have blue hair, blue skin, and wear blue overalls. It's revealed that the reason the girls are blue is due to them being ashy. Big Little Sister: Olei is the youngest but the biggest, Nubia is the middle child who is the tallest, and Gina's the oldest despite being the smallest. Big Sister Bully: Nubia towards Olei.

characters.name: Ms. Rhonda Hightower
characters.description: The principal of Willie T. Ribbs Middle School. While normally a meek and delicate lady, she isn't afraid toraise her voiceto get her students in line. Adults Are Useless: Heavily suggested given how the Gross Sisters (and other minor bullies) are allowed to run rampant with their schemes yet she does nothing to punish them. Beware the Quiet Ones: She has the presence of a mouse but can turn into a ferocious tiger when reclaiming order and attention. Black Boss Lady: She's African American and the head honcho of Penny's middle school. Flowery Insults: She can get pretty creative when insulting her students.Mrs. Hightower:I SAID QUIET YOU FUTURE HAMBURGER-FLIPPERS!!!...Thank you.

characters.name: Frankie White
characters.description: One of Penny's classmates from Willy T. Ribbs Aesop Amnesia: Any time he learns not to be aJerkass, expecting it to actually stick would just be wishful thinking. Jerkass: Frankie is rude and crass towards others, and easily gets jealous of other boys who takes the girls' attention away from him. In theLouder and Prouderepisode "Father Figures", he's one of the students who bullies Maya and KG for having two dads. Jerk Jock: Frankie is a sports jock with a jerkish, sexist attitude who gets overly competitive. Loving Bully: Despite the rivalry he has with Penny when it comes to sports, he is shown to also have a crush on Penny. He’s even upset (despite saying he’s okay with it) when he was told he was a rebound. It’s possible he said that because he was confident Penny would say no and genuinely like him back.

characters.name: The Talking Baby
characters.description: A red-nosed talking baby that torments Oscar. Bitch in Sheep's Clothing: He only talks when Oscar is around and torments Oscar, then acts like a regular baby around other people. Chuck Cunningham Syndrome: One of the few recurring characters from the original series who hasn't appeared inLouder and Prouder. Creepy Child: Even without the talking and the strangely un-childlike behavior, he's pretty strange looking. Enfant Terrible: He's an evil genius in the making, the true extent of which is never shown.

characters.name: Al Roker
characters.description: A Faustian version of the real-life TV weatherman (who voices himself). He happens to have powerful, wish-granting powers and serves as a minor antagonist in the series. Adam Westing: A bizarrelymean-spiritedvariant, the real-lifeNice GuyTV weatherman Al Roker plays thedecidedlyless niceTV weatherman Al Roker. The Atoner: Enforced. Due to his actions in "Tween Town", Roker's bosses forced him to make it up to Penny in "Twins to Tweens". He is a lot more cooperative this time around but of course that's mainly due to not wanting to lose his powers. It's implied the rules are still in effect, and he's required to add reasonable provisions to the wishes people make, like a trial period. Bald of Evil: He's mostly bald in the original series, and by the time ofLouder and Prouder, he’s completely bald to keep him up to date with his real life appearance at the time. Costume Evolution: Minor, but inLouder and Prouder, he is shown wearing glasses with purple frames, as real life Roker had taken up wearing different colored glasses at the time (including purple). He is also notably thinner to reflect Roker's gastric bypass surgery.

characters.name: Darnell Sisters
characters.description: Two elderly twins who are Suga Mama's rivals. Enemy Mine: They teamed with Suga Mama and Papi in “Hip-Hop Helicopter” at a bowling match, competing against a younger team consisting of Oscar, Trudy, Sunset and Felix. Friendly Rival: While, they’re arch rivals to Suga Mama, they don’t hold a grudge against her at all. Go-Karting with Bowser: In Louder and Prouder episodes “Grandma’s Hands”, they are playing poker with Suga Mama and Celia. Took a Level in Kindness: The Darnell Sisters appeared to have been on good terms with Suga Mama in the revival series, not even insulting her or anything.

characters.name: Reverend Haygood
characters.description: The Cameo: He made two cameos in Louder and Prouder in "It All Started with an Orange Basketball", where he called Oscar Proud evil only because Oscar's youth basketball program ruthlessly defeated his own team, and again in "Grandma's Hands", where he is shown baptizing Penny during her stay with Suga Mama.

characters.name: Freddy Frito
characters.description: Alisa Reyes(revival series) A businesswoman who makes a line of snacks which Felix Boulevardez likes. Felix is her biggest fan. In Snackland, she confronts Oscar Proud for stealing her idea of opening an amusement park named "Frito Land" to promote her snacks and threatens to file a lawsuit.

characters.name: Buff Man
characters.description: A recurring, nameless muscular character who serves a different role each time he appears. Typically, he's a security guard. The Ahnold: He's a caricature of Arnold Schwarzenegger, and speaks with a thick Austrian accent. To add to the reference, you'll sometimes hear him say “I'll be back”. No Name Given: He's a nameless, generic character used to fill whatever character role the plot demands, though one of his incarnation's names is Klaus. Super-Strength: He's strong enough to lift anentire house. You Don't Look Like You: When the character returns inLouder and Prouder, he has a wider face and wider body frame with blond hair instead of brown, but he does now look a lot closer to the archetype he's based off of.

characters.name: Marsha Mitsubishi
characters.description: A local news reporter. Alliterative Name:MarshaMitsubishi. Chuck Cunningham Syndrome: She vanishes without a trace by the time ofLouder and Prouder, having been since replaced by Vanessa Vue.

characters.name: Debra Williams
characters.description: Big Damn Heroes: Strangely enough, it's Thingy (Debra) who comes to Oscar's rescue whenthe babies mob him for not being Thingy. Body Horror:It's revealed that after crashing a vehicle while attempting to take out Shuggie, she’s become so deformed that her injuries fused with the inside of her Thingy suit, thus turning her into a human-slug monstrosity and keeps the suit on to mask herself. She’s unable to afford surgery because of how broke she's become. Broken Pedestal:Michael Collins was a fan of hers until he discovered what she had become after her show was cancelled. The Bus Came Back:Originally a one-shot character in the original series, she returns inLouder and Prouderin the season 4 episode, "The Diaper Academy". Depraved Kids' Show Host:InLouder and Prouder, she’s fully embraced her role as Thingy and went completely insane after her show got canceled and Shuggie took the spotlight. She's now forcing kids to make shoes for her with the help of other kid show personalities.

characters.name: Buffarina
characters.description: Introduced in the revival, Buffarina is the short, but no less intimidating assistant to Dr. Payne and sometimes serves as a bouncer in the Wizard Kelly Theater. Berserk Button:Mispronouncing her name. Oscar pays for this when he calls her "Buffalo".She also gets mad at Michael when he suggests calling her "Buffy." Mispronouncing her name. Oscar pays for this when he calls her "Buffalo". She also gets mad at Michael when he suggests calling her "Buffy." Brawn Hilda: She has masculine features such as very large muscles and a deep voice.

characters.name: Shuggie
characters.description: A talking giant panda who is introduced in the revival. He lives at the local zoo. Anthropomorphic Zig-Zag: While he can communicate with most people, the zookeeper he tried to scold in "Curved" only heard animalistic growling. Ascended to Carnivorism: He prefers meat over bamboo, claiming that bamboo is causing his species to go extinct. Beary Friendly: He's a giant panda who quickly befriends Penny. Talking Animal: He inexplicably has the ability to talk to humans. (And sing, too!)

characters.name: Makeup Boy
characters.description: Adam Smith Hates Your Guts: One of the things Penny doesn't like about Makeup Boy is how he constantly shills his products for each of his makeup techniques, which are priced very high. She's especially annoyed by how easily her friends are willing to spend their money on his products anyway or spend twenty dollars just to take a selfie with him. Bad Influencer: It's even the title of this episode. Makeup Boy gives ridiculous makeup tips and charges far too much money for his products. Later on, Penny uses her huge platform to canceleveryoneat the slightest provocation. Break the Haughty: Makeup Boy was introduced as an egotistical jerk who insults Penny to her face, but he quickly loses his following after Penny calls him out for his behavior on social media and effectively cancels him. Later on, he admits to Penny that this was something he needed, since he was "seduced by the juice" and let his social media fame go to his head. Easily Forgiven: He and Penny easily forgive each other for their actions against one another. Evil Laugh: He lets out an evil laugh that gradually becomes deeper after he insults Penny when she calls him out for ripping people off.

characters.name: Vanessa Vue
characters.description: She replaces the lost Marsha Mitsubishi as the show's primary news talent and just like her predecessor, she repeatedly claims to be in need of a job. Alliterative Name:VanessaVue. Ink-Suit Actor: She resembles her own voice actress,Brenda Song.

characters.name: Lisa Hill
characters.description: A substitute teacher at Willy T. Ribbs Middle School. She debuted in the episode Home School, filling in for the unseen Ms. Eckhart, who was absent due to childbirth. Ms. Hill is known for her cutthroat attitude which intimidates the student body. Faux Affably Evil: She affects the mannerisms of a hip friend or family member, but they're only a thin veneer that covers educational corruption at its worst incarnate in one woman. Hated by All: Because of her strict attitude and how she gives detentions for even the smallest demeanor, Ms. Hill isn't well-liked amongst the student body, especially not caring when she got fired. When Penny explains her donation drive to raise money for Ms. Hill, the students refuse to help out due to the suffering they had to endure from her, with one of the students declaring "it was a gift when she got fired". Even Principal Hightower doesn't show any sympathy and adds "no one cares". Jerkass Has a Point: In the episode "No Friend of Mine," she gives Trudy good advice about how to handle a situation in which you are stalking someone. She said that it is best for you to confront situations head on before they fester. She isn't wrong. My Beloved Smother: Suga Mama doesn't like Ms. Hill because she was Uncle Bobby's prom date and ruined his night. Ms. Hill shoots back it was because Suga Mamawas theresmothering him, which Oscar corroborates because Bobby doesn't even know how to use a knife in the present. Bobby also agrees and happily elopes with Ms. Hill.

characters.name: Kwame Washington
characters.description: Against My Religion:Impliedin "Curved" when Penny offers him one of the two bacon, egg, and cheese sandwiches she bought on the way to school. He turns it down because “I don’t eat swine”. The fact that he emphasized pork in that statement indicates he practices a religion that bans pork products, but what religion it is isn’t specified. Cool Teacher: He's pretty chill and laid back compared to other teachers in the school, and students are more comfortable going to him about their problems.

characters.name: Miss Brady
characters.description: Adoption Diss: She condescendingly denies that Christian A. Smith is a direct ancestor of Maya's father, Barry, and only concedes when Dijonay informs her that Maya is adopted. Even then, she dismisses it as not Maya's true family history. For added subtext, Mrs. Brady is a blonde, blue-eyed white woman. The Cameo: She made one in “Wiz Kid”, as one of the board members along with Miss Hill and Principal Hightower Heel–Face Turn: In the beginning, she was acting racist and antagonistic to Maya at the beginning of the episode, but after all of what Maya, her fellow students, and her parents fought for during the episode, she changed her tune as she was seen applauding Maya for her speech at the name-changing ceremony at the end of the episode. Protagonist-Centered Morality: Miss Brady, the history teacher, and Barry are treated as ignorant and stubborn for adhering to the revised version of Christian A. Smith's legacy, while Brother Kwame is treated as sagely for (wrongfully) vilifying Lincoln as if he stuck to the deportation plan for African-Americans.

characters.name: Talia Rogue
characters.description: The founder ofTeen Roguemagazine and a secret leader of the One Hundredth. Bad Boss: She is harsh to her workers to the point Michael had Penny take his place to avoid her harsh rant. She even fires them, literally. Penny isn’t safe from her either as she forces her to clean her polar bear rug. Bitch in Sheep's Clothing: While she can be more polite, she’s more aggressive on the outside. Jerkass: She’s rude to her employers, and even sarcastically told Penny she’s a reporter only to fire her. Pet the Dog: In the "Family-Verse" arc, she reassured Penny and Dijonay that their parents will be safe after they were kidnapped by Lucy Fur.

characters.name: Sir Paid-a-Lot
characters.description: Expy: a parody of Sir Mix-a-Lot and DMX.

characters.name: Mega
characters.description: After Penny suffered the consequences of illegally downloading music, she tells Mega that she does not like him anymore and would no longer be downloading any more music illegally. Affably Evil: Mega is a smooth, easygoing guy who legitimately seems to like Penny. He also runs a website that downloads music illegally also tries tokeep pressuring herintoillegally downloading music.

characters.name: Crandall Smythe
characters.description: The Rival: He was one to Oscar during the days of spelling bee. Sore Loser: He is one for losing to Oscar and for his son losing in the spelling bee competition.

characters.name: Timothy Smythe
characters.description: Cheaters Never Prosper: Timothy accepts help from the Gross Sisters, who feed him the answers through an earpiece, only for him to get caught due to the earpiece picking up a signal from a fast food restaurant's intercom. Graceful Loser: After the Spelling Bee was over, he, Penny and the Chang Triplets were able to make it to the Beach Retreat. Nice Guy: He’s pretty much a nice guy who doesn't have a bad bone in himself. Odd Friendship: He and Penny Proud got along because they both felt the same way about their dads obsessing over a Spelling Bee.

characters.name: Gertie Denkins
characters.description: Et Tu, Brute?: Ms. Dinkins' real reason for her hatred against Suga Mama is because Suga Mama tricked her with a two-headed coin to get Percy Proud, and has been angry all this time that her former best friend lied to her just to get a man. The Resenter: She has one towards Suga Mama. Sins of Our Fathers: Ms. Dinkins hates Suga Mama over stealing a guy they both crushed on, to the point of spitefully giving Penny a bad grade over a report she worked hard on. Suga Mama agrees to attend the parent-teacher conference in place of Oscar and Trudy, and once she finds out who Ms. Dinkins is,she's pissed off over her granddaughter being wronged and engages in a brawl.

characters.name: Dave Daniels
characters.description: Blatant Lies: Dave Daniels, old acquaintance of Oscar's claims that he holds nothing against how he and the other kids used to pick on him. And yet, he purposefully tells Oscar and Trudy it will be expensive to enrollBeBe and CeCeinto his school, milking his former bully for what it's worth.

characters.name: Credit Card
characters.description: The Corruptor: It influences Penny to buy as many expensive things as she wants, regardless of the consequences. Thankfully, she realizes she isn't responsible enough to resist the temptation and cuts it up. Ink-Suit Actor: The credit card is voiced by Steve Harvey, which even has his trademark mustache. Laser-Guided Karma: The credit card suffers this under the hands of Penny when the latter cuts him up (it's also due to the credit card refusing to bail her out of trouble when it got rejected when Penny tried to buy her friends some ice cream).

characters.name: Angels
characters.description: Light Is Good: They are very kind people and are Angels. Real After All: Turns out they were real and are from Heaven.

characters.name: The Whites
characters.description: Small Role, Big Impact: Not exactly that though while he and his family do appear after said Angels left, it made The Proud Family believe in Kwanzaa.

characters.name: JohnnyMcBride
characters.description: Bitch in Sheep's Clothing: He's this at first, before gradually becoming meaner and meaner, and eventually dropping the nice guy actentirely. Card-Carrying Jerkass:Implied. When Penny calls him out for being an asshole, he says that she's the first person who "actually sees him." Penny retorts that she seesthroughhim. Disability as an Excuse for Jerkassery: He starts outputting on a nice guy act, but gradually becomes meaner throughout the episode, eventually dropping the mask entirely thinking he can get away with it because of his disability. For a while, he does, but Penny eventually has enough of his attitude and breaks up with him. Disability Exploitation: The one-shot character JohnnyMcBride] turned out to be this. In a Valentine's Day episode, it was revealed that Penny Proud has a secret admirer who draws her face on walls, causing trouble for her and her friends and getting them suspended from school. When Penny and her friends investigated who had a crush on her, they discovered Johnny, who is in a wheelchair. Johnny only had to apologize to Penny and her friends and received no punishment. When talking to Penny, Johnny admitted he liked her and asked her to be his girlfriend; feeling bad about his wheelchair, she agreed. Johnny turned out to be a self-entitled jerk and bad boyfriend who used his wheelchair disability to exploit and guilt Penny and her family, and it’s implied that he’s been a baby all his life because of his wheelchair. After Johnny ruined Penny and her families vacation with his rude attitude, Penny broke up with him and told Johnny what a horrible person he was and that she only dated him because she felt sorry for him because of his wheelchair, but she doesn’t feel sorry for him anymore because of his awful personality and warned him that next time he paints her face on a wall, she will call the police on him. Domestic Abuse: While not one of the worst abusers in fiction, he is a creepily realistic example in that he starts out trying

characters.name: The Altos
characters.description: A gang of thugs who, like the Gross Sisters, steal money from others. They only appear in the episode of the same name. The group consists of Punch, Stomp and Slapmaster. Sticky temporarily joins them. Big, Thin, Short Trio: Punch is the big, Stomp is the short, and Slapmaster is the thin. Although Stomp is also thin, he's shorter in height than Slapmaster. Catchphrase: All three of them in a sing-song tone often say "We're The Altos!".Also Punch has said a couple of times "The Altos steal from everybody!" Also Punch has said a couple of times "The Altos steal from everybody!" Cheaters Never Prosper: They actually almost avert this. Thanks to Sticky getting the answers to the scavenger hunt ahead of time, The Altos actually won the competition at the end. However, Sticky finally confesses that he helped them cheat causing The Altos to be disqualified.

characters.name: Bethany Jones
characters.description: Alpha Bitch: She has qualities of them such as being shallow and looking down on people she doesn’t consider "cool." She didn’t start hanging out with her own cousin, Penny and her friends until they became popular from winning the Hip Hop Helicopter competition. She also looked down on the Change Triplets for being geeky. Female Misogynist: She seems to base other girls' self worth on the attention they get from older boys. This line basically sums it:Bethany:Okay, when they're (the older boys) not looking at you is when you need to be worried. Hate Sink: Bethany is basically a mix of Dijonay andLaCienega, but without any of their good qualities. Jerkass: Bethany is just a rude and unpleasant person. She even mistreats her own cousin sometimes (apparently treating your allies terriblyruns in the family). A scene that shows this perfectly was when she kicked her own cousin and her friends out of her car (while they were on the way to the hip-hop helicopter studio) because she wanted to pick up her other friends. Lack of Empathy: She apathetically tells the girls to "grow up" when they complain to her about how uncomfortable they are with the male attention they get at the party.

characters.name: Kwok Wong
characters.description: Arranged Marriage: Was in one in his debut episode due to a tradition of where his parents were from in China. It's ultimately called off by the end of the episode, though, due to the fact that he and his bride-to-be couldn't stand each other.

characters.name: Garrett Krebs
characters.description: Disproportionate Retribution: It's implied that he wanted tomurderthe Prouds all because they lived in his home and he had to watch them enjoy the things that he wish he had but he didn't. Driven by Envy: His motivation to murder the family was his envy of their happiness. Green-Eyed Monster: He envies the Prouds for being such a happy family to the point that he started resenting them. The Resenter: He resents Oscar for taking his happy family for granted because he envied what Oscar has.

characters.name: Sunny Stevens
characters.description: Freudian Excuse: The reason why Sunny's attitude wasn't the best is because she was fed up with the issues she was dealing with by being famous. Friendless Background: While crying in the trailer, she talks about how hard it is for her to make friends because some people think she’s already above them. Girlish Pigtails: Her character Iesha has these. I Just Want to Be Normal: As it turns out, Iesha isn't simply being a diva when her show returns. She's actually unhappy because she wanted the show to be cancelled so she could have a normal life for once. I Just Want to Be You: Subverted. Sunny doesn't want Penny's life. She tearfully talked about how she wanted Penny's lifestyle:Sunny:You said you wanted to be like me. Well, I want to be like you. Go to school, hang out with friends, be plain-looking, go get a burger atMcWizard's.

characters.name: Johnny Lovely
characters.description: Ambiguously Human: Whatever Johnny Lovely is, he takes the form of a teenage boy who mysterious vanishes and leaves books on what it means to be kind to people. The implication is that he’s some sort of guardian angel. Line-of-Sight Name: Whoever Johnny Lovely is, they picked up their name from the streetsJohnnyAvenue andLovelyLane. Maybe Magic, Maybe Mundane: Johnny Lovely is either a mysterious stranger with a knack of teaching kindness or just the personification of love that coincidentally took the name of a street address, leading everyone to question if he's a real person or not.LaCiengaJohnny Avenue and Lovely Lane? So you mean, he didn't exist?Zoey:I don't know. Do I exist? Do you exist? Nice Guy: He’s one chilling and loving dude. Sheep in Sheep's Clothing: Penny figures Johnny Lovely is too good to be true, that nobody could possibly look goodandbe good on the inside too. But as it turns out, he's a genuinely nice person with the face to match.

characters.name: Tory Haygood
characters.description: Face Palm: He makes one after Penny told him that Tabasco sent her the letter to the latter that was supposedly for Jenny. Nice Guy: Tory, who is mindful of Penny’s safety, but is romantically involved with Jenny.

characters.name: Jenny
characters.description: Nice Girl: She's shown herself to be friendly and seems to have developed a liking for Penny Proud and her friend group.

characters.name: René
characters.description: The Ace: She's beautiful, kind, excels at absolutely everything and isLoved by All. Beautiful Singing Voice: SingsexactlylikeAretha Franklin. Friend to All Children: She's an experienced nanny who gets along great with children and babies.BeBeandCeCeimmediately take a liking to her. Innocently Insensitive: She doesn't seem to notice how much she makes Trudy feel replaced. Loved by All:Everyoneloves her with the sole exception of Trudy (and evenshecan't help but admire how angelic she seems to be).

characters.name: Randi
characters.description: Benevolent Boss: Randi seems like a fair boss to her employees. Jerkass Ball: When she accuses Penny and her friends of selling the expensive watch and fires them. Then again, she does acknowledges that she was wrong for doing so. Nice Girl: She seems friendly to everybody.

characters.name: Clarence
characters.description: Good Parents: Considering his son, Max, grew up into a very mature and reasonable man who went through a lot of trouble just to find his father, it is likely Clarence/Roscoe was a good dad to his son. Nice Guy: He's nothing but kind and polite to the people around him. Oscar doesn't trust him at first. While many shows during the 2000s would normally have a one-shot character like this reveal to be a bad person,Clarence's kindness is genuine and he really is thankful and gracious to everything Suga has done for him. Their relationship was cut short mainly because he doesn't have the clearest idea of what is going on around him (likely due to dementia). It's a pretty emotional and even tragic twist on this common storyline that happened in a lot in cartoons from this era. The Reveal: Oscar believed Clarence was a gigolo who was only after Suga Mama's money.As it turns out, Clarence (whose real name is Roscoe) was never after her money and is really a kind old man who just happens to not know what is going on likely due to dementia from old age. Scatterbrained Senior:The twist of the episode. Clarence is an honestly nice guy, who is also the owner of a very successful chain of restaurants who happens to have dementia or Alzheimer's so advanced he didn't recall his own name. His son confirms that events like the episode happen commonly. Suga Mama let's him go on realizing that it just wouldn't work out. Single Woman Seeks Good Man: The genders are reversed in this situation.When he is absolutely lost, he always finds support from kind, sweet, and (according to his son Max, usually good looking ladies).

characters.name: Agatha Ordinario
characters.description: Beautiful Singing Voice: Despite her plain, nerdy appearance, she's a very talented singer. She can sing so beautifully that, during the Tween Idol finals, she moves normallyCaustic CriticPercival toManly Tears. Geek Physique: Similar to Zoey she has a very lanky figure with a long neck. Gonk: She is rather homely, so Oscar doesn't want her to win, and Wizard Kelly rigs the contest so that Agatha loses to the more conventionally prettyLaCieniga. Meaningful Name: Her last name, Ordinario, refers to her plain looks. However, once she sings, it becomes anIronic Name, as her talent is anything but ordinary. Nerd Glasses: Wears large, round frames. There’s even a creaking noise whenever she pushes them up.

characters.name: Tookie Thomas
characters.description: Dirty Coward: He becomes more afraid of Michael when the latter attacks him for his bullying. Jerkass: He bullied and mocked Michael for being “feminine” while calling him a sissy, and arguably only changed his waysin fear of not being attacked by Michael again.

characters.name: Chester the Duck
characters.description: Attention Whore: Only wants Penny's attention to himself which is why he drives away her friends despite Penny being very upset with him. Ax-Crazy: Chester constantly flips out on people for little to no reason. Especially if they come close to Penny. There is a reason he's referred to as "Psycho Duck", and he makes even Donald Duck look tame by comparison. Berserk Button: Chester will beat up anyone that gets even close to Penny. Even if they aren't doing her any harm. Also, Oscar himself has become this to Chester. Bitch in Sheep's Clothing: This is sorta played with. Chester only acts nice around Penny but is openly hostile toward her friends and family.The episode also pulls aBait-and-Switchwith everyone's opinion of him. It intially seems like Oscar is the only who notices his real personality. Then it turns out everyone was aware of how evil Chester was...Oscar's just the only one stupid enough not to play dumb to avoid getting attacked. The episode also pulls aBait-and-Switchwith everyone's opinion of him. It intially seems like Oscar is the only who notices his real personality. Then it turns out everyone was aware of how evil Chester was...Oscar's just the only one stupid enough not to play dumb to avoid getting attacked.

characters.name: Fifteen Cent
characters.description: Nice Guy: While he seems like a punk rapper at first glance, he's actually a pretty charming, polite, and friendly young man who respects how Penny looks after her friends and family. Put on a Bus: Doesn't appear after the movie. A relationship between him and Penny likely wouldn't have worked out anyway due to his busy life as a celebrity. The reboot also retcons the events of the movie as being a dream that Penny had. Satellite Love Interest: He is an easygoing rapper related to Sticky whom Penny is in love with. That's about all there is to know about him.

characters.name: Erika Lane Tucker
characters.description: Jerkass: She told Zoey she couldn't dance, thus effectively sending her to go home. Pet the Dog:She does at least give Penny a chance to join as a dancer. She was even impressed by Clone Oscar’s dancing moves.She also mentors the dancing disco peanuts in the end of the film. She does at least give Penny a chance to join as a dancer. She was even impressed by Clone Oscar’s dancing moves. She also mentors the dancing disco peanuts in the end of the film.

characters.name: Neato Tito
characters.description: Expy: a parody of Walter Mercado, a famous Hispanic television personality known for his astrology performances

characters.name: Death Wish (D.W.)
characters.description: Lizzo's bodyguard in the episode "Snackland". Brawn Hilda: She's muscular, tall and has a maculine appearance. Giant Foot of Stomping: She's large enough to stomp Oscar under her foot, turning him into anAccordion Man. Top-Heavy Guy: A female example of this trope. Her upper body is much larger than her lower body. The Voiceless: Doesn't utter a single word, but lets out anangry moo similar to a bull.

characters.name: Giselle
characters.description: Beware the Nice Ones: She is also mentally strong despite her sensitivity and Suga Mama describes her as "tough, like me!" Hidden Depths: She is creative, a positive thinker and is quick to solve problems. Giselle has apparently learned martial arts and was ready to thrown down with Suga Mama upon meeting her again, however, the normally pugnacious Suga Mama wasn't looking for a fight. Nice Girl: She is friendly and easy going but also sensitive.

characters.name: Gabby Douglas
characters.description: The Cameo: She appeared in "A Perfect Ten", alongside fellow legendary gymnast Dominique Dawes as a commentator at the Olympic Trials where her friend and former teammate Laurie Hernandez got to compete against upstart freak-athleteLa CienegaBoulevardez.

characters.name: Dominique Dawes
characters.description: The Cameo: Appeared in theLouder and Prouderepisode "A Perfect Ten" where she worked alongside fellow gymnast Gabrielle Douglas as commentator for the Olympic trials featuring the famous Laurie Hernandez and the infamousLaCienegaBoulevardez.

characters.name: Laurie Hernandez
characters.description: The Cameo: She made one in "A Perfect Ten", where she competes againstLaCienega.

characters.name: Emily
characters.description: Anachronism Stew: In her diary, Emily describes the celebration of Jubilee (precursor to Juneteenth) in 1827 when the first Jubilee celebrations actually happened in 1866, decades later than what she describes. Our Ghosts Are Different: Emily is of theUnfinished Businesstype due to her master's reputation as a slaveowner being censored and wants people to know the truth. Posthumous Character: From the 19th century, she had the misfortune of living when slavery was still legal in America,though her ghost implies that she did live long enough to see slavery abolished. Replacement Pedestal: After Christian A. Smith's reputation was destroyed, a statue of Emily was put in place of the other and Smithville was renamed Emilyville in her honor.

characters.name: Christian A. Smith
characters.description: Broken Pedestal: Up until this episode, Christian A. Smith is fondly remembered as the founder of Smithville. But once Penny and her friends reveal thathe was a slave owner, his reputationinvoked Condemned by History:In-Universeexample regarding Christian A. Smith; despite the fact that he was long celebrated as the town founder of Smithville,being a slave owneris enough for his reputation to be tainted forever. Easily Condemned: In-Universebeing a slave owneris enough for Christian A. Smith's reputation to be tainted forever, despite the fact that he's implied to have performed far more heroic deeds. Greater-Scope Villain: He's the one who was responsible for enslaving Emily and her family, same for being one of the two who founded Smithville. Irony: There's also the name of Christian A. Smith himself. "Christian" means "follower of Christ", and "Smith" is an occupational surname derived from the word "blacksmith". Meaning that "Christian A. Smith" literally means "a Christian blacksmith." Considering he was a slaveowner who made his slaves do the work for him, and thus acted contrary to the teachings of Jesus, this is a major case ofIronic Name.

characters.name: Betty Davis
characters.description: Compressed Hair: Appears undercover with short hair, but out of disguise has a larger hairstyle.

characters.name: Colin
characters.description: Affably Evil: Colin is nothing but a charming and polite person who greets Penny, Dijonay, and Betty as guests. Earn Your Happy Ending: After having suffered from aging backwards of his youth, he reverts back to his normal self thanks to Betty. Merlin Sickness: Suffers from an affliction which causes him to age backwards. Self-Made Man: He claims he became rich by buying bitcoin back when it was worth .05 cents.

characters.name: Fabrice and Driss
characters.description: Bitch in Sheep's Clothing: While they are charming and very polite towards Penny and Dijonay, they're more manipulative. Face–Heel Turn: While they were nice at least, they helped Lucy Fur find the key for the map of eternal life. Nothing Personal: When Penny asked Fabrice why they're helping Lucy, the latter responds to her saying it's nothing personal.

characters.name: Lucy Fur
characters.description: Evil Is Hammy: She is voiced by comedianJanelle James. Expy: Her luxurious fur coat, angry red eyes and even her name all draw similarities toCruella de Vil. Fallen Hero: Implied. When Lucy threatens to take them down, Betty jokingly tells Penny and Dijonay that it was the reason why she got kicked out of the One Hundreth, meaning that she used to work for the organization before being kicked out. Fur and Loathing: A villain with a fur coat and fur as her last name. Noodle Incident: When Lucy threatens to take them down, Betty jokingly tells Penny and Dijonay that it was the reason why she got kicked out of the One Hundreth.

characters.name: Henchie
characters.description: The Dragon: She serves Lucy Fur. No Name Given: Her name is never brought up in the show and the credits only label her as "White Woman". Though she's called Henchieby the art directors. Trademark Favorite Food: She's always shown sipping on Boba tea, and shooting the tapioca out of the straw asammunition. Vocal Dissonance: In contrast to her feminine appearance, and the giggle she lets out earlier on, she sounds like a deep-voiced man when she cries over her spilled boba. The Voiceless: Besides laughing and crying, she doesn't say much.

characters.name: Rosa Lee Davenport
characters.description: Jerkass Realization: She started to realize her behavior of beautty pageants. Heel–Face Turn: After realizing how her actions affected Dijonay, she apologized for her colorist behaviour. Sub-Par Supremacist: Imposes a strict beauty standard, while she herself wears a wig.

characters.name: Breyana
characters.description: Boyish Short Hair: Has short hair compared to her daughter. Jerkass Realization: She has one after realizing how selfish she was towards Maya. Strong Family Resemblance: Has her daughter’s eyes and nose shape.

characters.name: Damien the Destroyer
characters.description: A video game player in the videogame tournament. Disproportionate Retribution: He temporarily ruined Penny’s video game reputation just to humiliate her for having embarrassed him from the videogame tournament. The Dreaded: He’s called “Damien The Destroyer”, for a reason. Enfant Terrible: After being beaten by Penny, the much younger player Damien spends rumours she cheated and goes as far as to dox her to get revenge. Evil Is Petty: He spreaded rumors as a hacker of Penny having cheated and wanting to do it for girls out of spite for being humiliated by her.Even KG and the guysare disgusted by this.

characters.name: Breadwinner
characters.description: A video game player in the videogame tournament. Samus Is a Girl: Breadwinner is revealed to be a girl upon taking off her helmet. After a brief moment of silence, the cheering she had gotten earlier resumes. Second Place Is for Winners: WhileBreadwinneris the winner of the tournament, she congratulates Penny for inspiring her, giving Penny the trophy in the process.

characters.name: Noah Doll
characters.description: Killer Robot: Professor NoahDollafter starts malfunctioning turns into one of these atBubbaLandwhen encountering the Wiz Kids. Oscar ends upbearing the brunt of his abusewhen sent by the Wizard to deal with the situation. Punny Name: Noah Doll is a play on "Know-It-All". Robotic Reveal: Professor Doll is revealed to be an android after suffering aRepetitive Audio Glitchduring the middle of a lecture.

characters.name: Big Bone Bronax
characters.description: From Nobody to Nightmare: She started off as being clumsy and unskilled. As soon as she improved, she became one of the most aggressive and meanest bomber. Green-Eyed Monster: Despite her becoming more successful than Suga Mama as a bomber, she still envied how Suga Mama was well loved and the most popular. Heel–Face Turn:After being defeated by Suga Mama, she apologizes and turns over a new leaf. Jerkass Realization:She realizes that she was wrong for being so envious and hateful towards Suga Mama. Took a Level in Badass: She improved as a bomber and got into much better shape after she started off as very clumsy and uncoordinated.

characters.name: Guadalupe
characters.description: Huge Guy, Tiny Girl: The tiny girl to her husband Madero's huge guy. Obnoxious In-Laws: While she didn't appear in the original show, it was implied that she didn't like Felix as he objected the idea of moving in with her. However,the oppositeturns out to be true in her official appearance: Felix loves her and Sunset is the one who can't stand her.

characters.name: Madero
characters.description: Huge Guy, Tiny Girl: The huge guy to his wife Guadalupe's tiny girl. Scatterbrained Senior: Besides failing to notice Guadalupe's absence (despite her leaving hours ago), he also mistakes Oscar for Felix, thinking Felix lost weight. Top-Heavy Guy: Has thin legs in contrast to hischubby and muscularupper frame.
